notes: DR Position Calculator dynamic-grid research update: calculated UTM + Lat/Lon mini-map, 500 m configurable local grids with automatic forward grid generation, persistent historical grids and calculated track, GNSS comparison/reference track, GNSS-exclusion test mode, session logging, and selectable speed source including ELM327-compatible OBD-II USB standard vehicle-speed PID 010D.
